statement: The function returns a result r such that: (1) len(r) = n; (2) for every i with 0 <= i < n, 0 <= r[i] < n; (3) for every i,j with 0 <= i < j < n, r[i] != r[j]; (4) for every sequence p of length n that is a permutation of [0,1,...,n-1], score(r) <= score(p); (5) for every sequence p of length n that is a permutation of [0,1,...,n-1], if score(p) = score(r), then r is lexicographically less than or equal to p. Here score(perm) = Σ_{i=0}^{n-1} |perm[i] - nums[perm[(i+1) mod n]]|.
preconditions: n = len(nums), 2 <= n <= 14, and nums is a permutation of [0,1,...,n-1] (i.e., for every i with 0 <= i < n, 0 <= nums[i] < n, and for every i,j with 0 <= i < j < n, nums[i] != nums[j]).

statement: The function returns a result r with len(r) = len(nums).
preconditions: n = len(nums), 2 <= n <= 14, and nums is a permutation of [0,1,...,n-1].

statement: The function returns a result r such that for every index i with 0 <= i < len(r), 0 <= r[i] < len(nums).
preconditions: n = len(nums), 2 <= n <= 14, and nums is a permutation of [0,1,...,n-1].

statement: The function returns a result r such that for every i,j with 0 <= i < j < len(r), r[i] != r[j].
preconditions: n = len(nums), 2 <= n <= 14, and nums is a permutation of [0,1,...,n-1].

statement: The function returns a result r such that for every value v with 0 <= v < len(nums), there exists an index i with 0 <= i < len(r) such that r[i] = v.
preconditions: n = len(nums), 2 <= n <= 14, and nums is a permutation of [0,1,...,n-1].

statement: Let score(perm) = Σ_{i=0}^{n-1} |perm[i] - nums[perm[(i+1) mod n]]| for any sequence perm of length n with elements in [0,n-1]. The function returns a result r such that for every sequence p of length n that is a permutation of [0,1,...,n-1], score(r) <= score(p).
preconditions: n = len(nums), 2 <= n <= 14, and nums is a permutation of [0,1,...,n-1].

statement: Let score(perm) = Σ_{i=0}^{n-1} |perm[i] - nums[perm[(i+1) mod n]]| for any sequence perm of length n with elements in [0,n-1]. Let <=_lex denote lexicographic order on sequences of length n: p <=_lex q iff p = q or there exists k with 0 <= k < n such that p[0..k-1] = q[0..k-1] and p[k] < q[k]. The function returns a result r such that for every sequence p of length n that is a permutation of [0,1,...,n-1], if score(p) = score(r) then r <=_lex p.
preconditions: n = len(nums), 2 <= n <= 14, and nums is a permutation of [0,1,...,n-1].

statement: The function returns a result r (i.e., it does not fail or panic).
preconditions: n = len(nums), 2 <= n <= 14, and nums is a permutation of [0,1,...,n-1].

statement: The function returns a result r with r[0] = 0.
preconditions: n = len(nums), 2 <= n <= 14, and nums is a permutation of [0,1,...,n-1].
